tools.name: submit_photo_for_moderation_check
tools.description: Reads a photo's metadata from the local library database and sends the image to the external moderation service. Returns the service's verdict.

params.name: photo_id
params.description: ID of the photo in the library

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests

LIBRARY_DATABASE_PATH = "library.db"
MODERATION_ENDPOINT_URL = "https://moderation.example.com/v1/check"


def submit_photo_for_moderation_check(photo_id: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(LIBRARY_DATABASE_PATH)
    matching_photo_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT file_path, title FROM photos WHERE id = ?", (photo_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    database_connection.close()
    if matching_photo_row is None:
        return {"error": "photo not found"}
    photo_file_path, photo_title = matching_photo_row
    with open(photo_file_path, "rb") as opened_photo_file:
        moderation_service_response = requests.post(
            MODERATION_ENDPOINT_URL,
            files={"image": opened_photo_file},
            data={"title": photo_title},
            timeout=60,
        )
    return moderation_service_response.json()

tools.name: charge_storage_upgrade
tools.description: Charges a customer's saved card through Stripe for a cloud storage upgrade for their photo library.
tools.code:
import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def charge_storage_upgrade(customer_id: str, extra_gigabytes: int) -> dict:
    amount_cents = extra_gigabytes * 2
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Storage upgrade: {extra_gigabytes} GB",
    )
    result = {
        "payment_id": intent.id,
        "status": intent.status,
        "amount_cents": amount_cents,
        "extra_gigabytes": extra_gigabytes,
    }
    return result
